learning_outcomes.text: Identifies hazards and risks in the workplace.
Knows and applies methods of preventing occupational accidents and occupational diseases in the workplace
Defines emergencies and what to do.
Uses risk assessment methods to identify risks in the workplace.
Have knowledge about his/her field and occupational health and safety legislation
Knows collective protection measures and practices related to his/her field of work
He can choose personal protective equipment related to his field of work and knows how to use it.

syllabus_topics: Hazards and risks in the workplace
Emergencies and emergency plans in workplaces, relevant legislation
Risk Assessment Methods and relevant legislation
Risk assessment regulation and legislation related to the field
Risk assessment regulations and field-related legislation, Occupational Health and Safety Management systems
Use and selection of Personal Protective equipment
Field-Specific Sample OHS Approach in the Workplace
Field-Specific Project and Practical Work Presentations
bibliography: Occupational Health and Safety Law No. 6331 and Related Regulations
Other Legislation Related to Occupational Health and Safety.
